Name: Haunted Woods Farm
Author: Morghoula
Description:
[center][size=5][b][i][color=#dd7e6b]﻿The villagers of Pelican Town say that the farm you've inherited is haunted...
[/color][/i][/b][/size][/center][center][/center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9799]
[/url][center][b]<﻿------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------->[/b][b]
[/b][/center]﻿

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WpPfgdL.png[/img]
[list]
[*]A moderate sized map, featuring in at 80 x 70 tiles
[*]A dock in the top right-hand corner of the map which allows you to swim in the lake and regain energy
[*]Daily forage spawns
[*]Boulders, logs, and stumps that spawn in certain areas (these [i]do not[/i] respawn daily)
[*]Access to the minecart system once repaired in the Community Center. 
[*]NPC barriers around the foliage so your animals can't hide from you under it. Foliage can be walked under by the farmer.
[*]Seasonal tilesheets. The custom haunted woods background sprites change colors depending on the season.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/j0R2u7A.png[/img]
[b][color=#ff0000][size=3]This map is only compatible on devices that have Stardew Valley 1.6 or later!
[/size][/color][/b]
Once you have downloaded and extracted the mod to your Stardew Valley/Mods folder, do the following:
[list=1]
[*]Open Stardew Valley via SMAPI
[*]When creating a new save, you will see an option for an additional map called "Haunted Woods Farm". Select it.
[/list]
